name: pdb-tools
summary: Stream-based editing, filtering and renumbering of legacy PDB coordinate files.

argv: from importlib.metadata import version; from pdbtools.pdb_selchain import run; a='ATOM  '+' '*15+'A'+' '*30+'\n'; b='ATOM  '+' '*15+'B'+' '*30+'\n'; out=list(run([a,b], {'A'})); assert out==[a], out; assert version('pdb-tools')=='2.7.0'; print('pdb-tools chain selection OK')

notes: The verification filters two synthetic PDB-format lines locally; it does not download a structure or alter research files.

pdb-tools operates on legacy PDB records. Its mmCIF converters have PDB-format atom/residue limits; use a dedicated mmCIF library such as Gemmi for large structures. This is not a geometry optimization or structure-prediction engine.
The pinned release publishes a universal Python wheel with no declared dependencies. Only the listed host architectures and Python versions are reviewed here.
